query: FeCoNiCrAl high-entropy alloys are promising bond-coat candidates because of their mechanical properties and elevated-temperature oxidation resistance. Earlier HVAF-M3 work identified 15–45 μm feedstock as optimal for high-quality coatings, but applying the same composition and size range with the HVAF-i7 torch yielded acceptable coating quality yet inadequate thickness. Separate studies of conventional MCrAlY bond coats using the M3 system reported a slight gain in deposition efficiency at higher particle velocity and nozzle-specific best spray distances of 300 and 350 mm. The design target is a sufficiently thick, adherent bond coat that retains coating integrity, minimal as-sprayed oxidation, and durability during high-temperature thermal-barrier service, including deposition within internal diameters as small as 120 mm. What single intervention could overcome the thickness limitation? State the hypothesized intervention and mechanism, predict the outcome relative to the 15–45 μm-feedstock baseline, define the deposition and service conditions under which it should remain effective, identify supporting evidence from the cited prior studies, and propose a controlled experiment with a clear result that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: Increasing particle velocity using the HVAF-i7 torch by optimizing spray distance and powder feed rate will result in increased coating thickness while maintaining coating integrity and minimal as-sprayed oxidation.
generation.intervention: Increase particle velocity using the HVAF-i7 torch by optimizing spray distance and powder feed rate
generation.conditions: Spray distance of 300-350 mm, powder feed rate of 20-30 g/min, and particle velocity of 500-600 m/s
generation.mechanism: Improved particle flattening and increased deposition efficiency due to higher particle velocity
generation.predicted_outcome: Increased coating thickness by 20-30% compared to the baseline, while maintaining coating integrity and minimal as-sprayed oxidation
generation.boundary: Deposition within internal diameters as small as 120 mm
generation.uncertainty: The actual increase in coating thickness may vary depending on the specific operating conditions and material properties

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the coating thickness and properties of FeCoNiCrAl high-entropy alloy coatings deposited using the HVAF-i7 torch with optimized spray distance and powder feed rate to those deposited using the standard parameters
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the coating thickness and properties of the coatings deposited using the optimized parameters are not significantly improved compared to the standard parameters, the hypothesis is falsified
